FeatureCapabilities.description: Mirrors PromptCapabilities: every field is optional and has a boolean default, so a Default() constructor is generated.

RootCapabilities.description: Mirrors AgentCapabilities: a nested capability field defaults via the nested type's own Default() constructor.

ProtocolVersion.description: Mirrors the real schema's ProtocolVersion def, present so the generated methods_gen.go's CurrentProtocolVersion constant (typed as ProtocolVersion) compiles in the behavior-test fixture bundle.

NotDefaultable.description: Has a default field but also a required field with none, so no Default() should be generated.
